topic: Review of spec folder 034-spec-template-context-optimizations: six 033-recommendation optimizations

focus: D3 Traceability - Core protocols spec_code + checklist_evidence

findingDetails.title: Packet docs stale: 'no implementation started' vs uncommitted full-phases implementation
findingDetails.evidence: docs claim no code touched; git status shows uncommitted changes to all §3 surfaces + 2 new files; mtimes 16:41-18:05 post-date docs 14:54

findingDetails.title: REQ-004 acceptance 'warn severity' unmet: AC_COVERAGE never emits warn status

findingDetails.title: REQ-001 level-contract field absent from spec-kit-docs.json documents schema
findingDetails.evidence: documents entries have no level key; lazyAddonDocs names research/research.md; REQ-001 names a level contract field

focus: D4 Maintainability - Cross-doc structure, template consolidation quality, naming clarity

findingDetails.title: Cross-doc phase-number collision: plan.md Phase N != tasks.md Phase N
findingDetails.evidence: plan.md Phases 1-4 = impl workstreams; tasks.md Phase 1-3 = setup/impl/verification lifecycle + Impl Phase P1-P4
findingDetails.recommendation: Rename tasks.md lifecycle phases (e.g. Stage 1-3) or add an explicit REQ-to-task mapping table

findingDetails.recommendation: State the achieved architecture precisely in the completion narrative or finish extracting a shared core

findingDetails.title: AC_COVERAGE manual-infeasible escape hatch undocumented at packet level
findingDetails.evidence: ADR-003 names the hatch but not classification criteria; rule requires three-token class match + evidence at check-ac-coverage.sh:147
findingDetails.recommendation: Document classification + evidence rule in validation-rules.md and the packet

focus: REQ-001 gating completeness - per-level render contract for research.md.tmpl
